findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Frequently asked questions" → 3 lines (3 words, 52px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 2 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "Board-level work under the microscope", "Screen replacement on the bench"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 3 gradient fill(s): section.hero-stage.relative → radial-gradient(50% 70% at 50% 52%, rgba(237, 28, 36, 0.16), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%), radial-gradient(120% 90% a | div.hero-phone-light.pointer-events-none → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(237, 28, 36, 0.55), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.hero-phone-flash.pointer-events-none → radial-gradient(circle at 86% 68%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95), rgba(255, 120, 120, 0.35) 14%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 5 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(237, 28 | button.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(237, 28 | button.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(237, 28
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: 32 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.sticky.top-0 1440px | ul.mt-12.grid 1165px | li.group.relative 388px | li.group.relative 388px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The h1 is 16px ("Cracked screen? Dead battery? Fixed same day in Ak").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "SPEEDY" (screen 1, 25% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Little motion: 10 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Use our instant quote tool or call us" above "3"; "Walk in or schedule an appointment" above "4"; "Board-level work under the microscope" above "Why choose us"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "FREE Smartphone when you sign up for Home Intern" → 3 lines (9 words, 24.1px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: No visible button in the first phone screen.
findings.fix: On a phone the first screen still holds the headline, the supporting sentence and the action; move navigation into one row or a menu so it does not push them down.
